connect.title: Connect to your piste
connect.scanHint: Point the camera at the poule sheet or the match card.
connect.blockedUntil: Too many attempts. Try again at {{time}}.

error.invalid: Wrong code. Check the six digits for your piste.
error.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
error.network: No connection to the server. Check the venue network.

ended.token_expired: The session expired after 60 minutes without activity. Connect again.
ended.token_revoked: Another device took over this piste.

help.title: Where is the code?
help.step1: Each piste has its own code.
help.step2: The QR is on the poule sheet or the match card.
help.step3: Or ask the organiser for the six digits.
help.reuse: It works more than once — leaving and coming back costs six digits.

scan.title: Scan QR
scan.hint: Point the camera at the code on the poule sheet.
scan.permissionBody: The camera is used only to read the QR code on the poule sheet. You can connect with the PIN instead.

error.unrecognised: QR code not recognised. Check that it is the code on the poule sheet.
error.unsupportedVersion: This QR code was generated by a newer version of the platform. Update the app.
error.insecure: This QR code points to a server without HTTPS ({{url}}). The app only connects over HTTPS.

poule.empty: No bouts in this poule yet.

error.title: Could not load the bouts
error.body: The server did not answer. Check the connection and try again.

readOnly.withBracket: Poule closed — the competition moved on to the elimination table ({{done}}/{{total}} matches decided). Each match has its own six-digit code: ask for the one for your piste.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.notEnoughFencers: The poule needs at least two fencers.

bout.title: Bout {{sequence}}

info.title: This bout
info.howClock: Tap the display to start and stop the time.
info.howTouch: Tap a score to add a touch; the − key takes one back.
info.howCards: Tap a card to give it; press and hold it to undo it.

priority.decidingTouch: Priority to {{name}} — record the deciding touch.

give.red: Red card for {{name}} — awards a touch to the opponent

bout.leaveMessage: The touches counted in this bout will not be saved.

time.title: Adjust time
time.subtitle: The timer is local to the referee. Adjusting it changes nothing on the platform.

bout.loadingHint: Fetching the touches, the time and the periods from the server.

conflict.title: Already recorded
conflict.message: Someone else recorded this bout: {{a}}–{{b}}, at {{time}}.
conflict.messageUnknown: Someone else recorded this bout first.

error.gone: This bout no longer exists — a fencer was removed from the poule. The result was not saved.

events.title: What happened
events.subtitle: Most recent first. The time is the one shown on the clock.
events.empty: Nothing has happened in this bout yet.

timer.title: Timer
timer.newBoutMessage: The current score and cards will be cleared.
timer.leaveMessage: Nothing from this bout is saved.

session.offline: No connection. The app keeps trying and nothing is lost.
session.expiring: The session ends in {{minutes}} min. Generate a new code on the platform to carry on.
session.leaveMessage: The session ends here. Connect again any time with the same six-digit code.
session.leaveQueued_one: {{count}} result is still waiting for the network. It stays on this phone and is sent the next time you connect.
session.leaveQueued_other: {{count}} results are still waiting for the network. They stay on this phone and are sent the next time you connect.
session.finishMessage: Nothing is left to referee on this piste. Connect again with the same code if you need to come back.

queue.pending_one: {{count}} result saved on this phone, waiting for the network.
queue.pending_other: {{count}} results saved on this phone, waiting for the network.

notice.conflict: {{label}} had already been recorded by someone else ({{detail}}). Your result was not applied.
notice.gone: {{label}} no longer exists — a fencer was removed. The result was not saved.
notice.expired: {{label}} waited more than 24 h and was discarded. The result never reached the server.
notice.full: {{label}} was not saved — the queue is full (50 results). Find a network before recording more.

queue.stranded_one: {{count}} result belongs to a piste you are no longer connected to. Connect again with that code to send it.
queue.stranded_other: {{count}} results belong to pistes you are no longer connected to. Connect again with those codes to send them.

waiting.title: Waiting for the previous round
waiting.body: This piste is yours. The bout opens on its own as soon as the previous round is decided — there is nothing to do here until then.
